content: Elisa Sewesehda Liohdi Semwehmwe men

Liohdi men me eh pwoudo kisehn pwihnen soukohp ko ahpw patohla rehn Elisa oh patohwanohng, “Maing, ei pwoudo melahr! Nin duwen me komwi mwahngih, ohl masak Koht men ih, ahpw met ohl emen me e pweipwandkihong mwohni, patohdo rehi pwehn adihasang ie nei pwutak riemen oh wiahkihla nah lidu, pwehn kapwungkihla en ei pwoudo eh pweipwando.”
Elisa eri sapeng, patohwan, “Dahme I kak sewesehkin komwi? Dahme mie ni imwomwo?” A liho sapengki, “Sohte mehkot, ihte kisin sahen lehn olip kis.”
Elisa ahpw patohwanohng, “Kohwei rehn mehn mpomw kan oh peki re en kamangaiong komwi mahs sah me sohte kanenge uwen tohto me kak.
Eri, komwi oh noumwi pwutak kan pahn pedolong nan imwamwailo, ritingedi wenihmwo, oh tapihada audehki leh sah kan. Kumwail eri koasoanehdi ehuehu sah mwurin eh audaudahr.”
Liho eri patohla ni imweo iangahki nah pwutak ko, ritingedi wenihmwo, oh ale kisin sahen lehn olipo oh audehkihda sah ko, nindokon nah pwutak ko ar wie dendelingekidohng reh sah ko.
Ni arail audedahr sah ko, liho eri idek ma mie luhwen sah me saikinte audaud. Emen nah pwutak ko eri sapengki, “Ihte luhwehn men.” Kisin sahen leho eri sohla pwilipwilidi.

Liho eri pwurala rehn Elisa, soukohpo eri patohwanohng, “Netikihla sahen leh kan oh kapwungkihla omwi pweipwand koaros, oh e pahn pil mie luhwen mwohni ong komwi oh noumwi pwutak kan pwe kumwail en mourki.”
Elisa oh Lih Kepwehpwe men sang Sunem
Rahn ehu Elisa ahpw patohla Sunem. Wasa me lih kepwehpwe men kin kousoan ie. Liho eri lukehdo pwe en sak reh. Eri, sang ni ahnsowo kohla ma e kin patohla Sunem, e kin iang sak ni imwen liho.
Eri, pak tohto Elisa ahpw kin ieiang sak wasao. Rahn ehu liho ahpw patohwanohng eh pwoudo, “I kamehlele me ohl menet me kin kalap kohdo rehta, iei ih ohl sarawi men.
Ia duwen, e seu konehng kita en wiahda ekis kisin perehn powe, oh kihong ehu pehten, oh tehpel, oh sehr, oh lamp, pwe ni eh pahn kin pwarodo rehta, en kak kommoaldi loale?”
Eri, rahn ehu, ni Elisa eh pwarodohng Sunem, e ahpw patohla nan kisin pereo pwe en kommoaldi ie.
E ahpw patohwanohng Keasi, eh laduwo, en ekerodo mahs liho. Ni liho eh leledo,

soukohpo ahpw patohwanohng Keasi, “Idek rehn lihen dahme I kak dupukiong eh sawas me e kihong kita. Mweinele e pahn mwahuki I en peki mehkot rehn nanmwarki de rehn kaun lapalap en karis kan.” A liho sapengki, “Soh. Sohte, pwe I inenen nsenamwahu wasaht, nanpwungen nei aramas akan.”
Elisa ahpw kalelapak rehn Keasi, “Eri, dahme I kak wiahiong liho?” Keasi eri sapengki, “Ihte, soahng wet: pwe sohte nah seri oh eh pwoud likeilapalahr.”
Elisa eri patohwanohng Keasi en pwurehng ekerodo liho.

Liho eri kohdo kesihnenda nan wenihmwo, oh Elisa ahpw patohwanohng, “Ni soangen ahnsou wet, nan sounpar kohkohdo, komw pahn roporopohnge noumw pwutak emen.” Liho ahpw sapeng, patohwan, “Maing! Komwi ohlen Koht men, komw dehr pitih ie.”
Eri, nan pahren mwurio, ni ahnsou me Elisa kohpada duwe, liho ahpw liseianda oh naitikihada nah pwutak emen.
Kisin pwutako eri keirda oh laudla. Rahn ehu e ahpw kohieila rehn soundolung wahnsahpw ekei, wasa eh pahpao mihmi ie.
Mwadangete e werkihong eh pahpao, nda, “Ipa, I moangmedekdahr, I moangmedekdahr!” Eh pahpao eri ndaiong ladu men en ale kisin pwutako oh tangahkilahng rehn eh nohno.
Laduwo eri kapwurehla pwutako rehn eh nohno, liho ahpw kamwodangedi kisin pwutako pohn kepeo lel nin souwas; pwutako ahpw mehla.
Liho eri wahdalahng nan en Elisa pereo. E ahpw kaunehdiong nan pehto oh ritingedi wenihmwo; ih eri pedoisang.
Liho ahpw ekerdo eh pwoudo oh ndaiong, “Kadarodo rehi emen laduwen oh emen ahsen, pwe I pahn kohla rehn soukohp Elisa. I pahn mwadang pwurodo.”
A eh pwoudo idek reh, “Dahme ke men kohkiwei rahnwet, pwe rahnwet kaidehkin rahn Sarawien Maram Pwul de rahnen Sapad.
A liho sapeng, ndalahng, “Mehnda, I pahn kohlahte.”
Ni mehkoaros eh soandier rehn ahso, liho ahpw ndaiong eh laduwo, “Nna, katanga marahra; oh ke dehpa uhdi, I lao ndawei.” Liho eri mwesel oh kohkohla rehn Elisa pohn Nahna Karmel.
Elisa eri kilenglahte kilangada liho sang wasa doh, eh tangatang kohdong reh. E ahpw patohwanohng eh ladu Keasi, “Kilang, pwe lihen Sunemo me kohkohdo.
Tangewei reh oh idek ma irail koaros me kehlail, iangahki eh pwoud oh nah pwutako.” Liho eri sapeng, “Kiht koaros me kehlail.”

Ahpw ni eh lel rehn Elisa, e poarolahngete pohn neh kan koledi. A Keasi keilahng mpe pwe en sikenla sang wasao; a Elisa patohwanohng, “Pweisang lih menet, pwe e inenen diren nsensuwed, ahpw KAUN-O ketin ekihsang ie oh sohte kasalehiong ie.”
Liho eri patohwan, “Maing, dah, ngehi me pekihda rehmwi I en neitik? I seu patohwanohng komwi en dehpa pitihiehdi?”

Elisa eri sohpeilahng Keasi oh patohwanohng, “Mwadang! Ale ei sokonet, kowe eri tangewei. Ke dehpa uhdi oh rahnmwahwih mehmen me ke pahn tuhwong nanialo, ma mehmen pahn rahnmwahwihiuk, ke dehpa sapeng. Ke pahn inenenwei ni imwo, ke ahpw pahn kihdiong ei sokonet pohn pwutako.”
Liho ahpw patohwanohng Elisa, “I kahukihla ni mwaren KAUN-O, oh ong komwi, me I sohte pahn patopatohla sang komwi!” Elisa eri uhda oh iangala.

Keasi tiengla mwohra oh kihdiong sokono pohn kisin pwutako; ahpw sohte mwahn kisin ngihl kis de kisin mwomwen mour kis reh. Iei me Keasi pwurala pwe en tuhwong Elisa oh padahkihong me pwutako sohte mourda sapahl.
Ni Elisa eh lella mwo, e ahpw pedolong kelehpw nan pereo oh kilangada kisin pwutako eh melahr oh wonohn nan pehto.
Elisa ahpw pedolong nan pereo oh ritingedi wenihmwo; e ahpw kapakapohng KAUN-O.

E ahpw doudahng pohn pehto, oh wendiong pohn kisin pwutako, oh kainenehdiong ewe pohn ewen pwutako, mese ko pohn mese ko, peh ko pohn peh ko; oh ni eh ideidahng kisin pwutako, paliweren pwutako pa karakarada.
Elisa eri uhda oh aluseli nan pereo. Mwuri, e ahpw pil pwurehng doudahng pohn pehto, oh wendiong pohn pwutako oh ideidahng. Pwutako ahpw asi pak isuh, e ahpw pehdpeseng.
Elisa eri likwerihedo Keasi oh patohwanohng, “Ekerodo liho.” Liho eri pwarodo rehn Elisa, a Elisa patohwanohng, “Ale noumw serien.”
Liho eri poaridi mwohn Elisa lel nanpwel; e ahpw ale nah pwutako oh patopatohla.
Pil Manaman Riau

Ahnsou ehu, ni lehk lapalap ehu eh kipehdi sahpwo, Elisa ahpw pwuralahng Kilkal. Nindokon eh wie padapadahk ong pwihnen soukohp ehu, e ahpw patohwanohng nah laduwo en kihong ehu lapalahn einpwoat en pohn kisinieio oh wiahda kanarail suhpw.
Emen irail ahpw kohieila nansapwo pwehn ale tehndipw. E ahpw diarada kord
kei oh dolungada uwen me e kak wahda. E ahpw wahla oh serediong nan suhpwo, ni eh sasairki dahkei mwo.
Irail eri toukada pilen suhpwo pwe re en tungoale, ahpw ni ahnsou me re tungoale re ahpw werida oh ndalahng Elisa, “Pwoisin!”—Re ahpw sohla tungoale.
Elisa eri pekihda ekis pilawa, ih eri kesehdiong nan einpwoato, oh patohwan, “Pwurehng toukehng irail suhpwen.” Suhpwo eri sohla katik.

Pil ehu ahnsou, ohl emen ahpw kohsang Paal Salisa, wa kodohng rehn Elisa lopwon en pilawa rieisek me wiawihda sang tepin dondoal en parli nan pahro, iangahki ekei wahn pilawa me ahpwtehn dondoalda. Elisa eri patohwanohng nah laduwo en katungoalehki pwihn soukohpo pilawa ko,
a laduwo ndahng, “Komwi kupwukupwure me e pahn itarohng aramas epwiki?” Elisa eri sapengki, “Kihong re en tungoale, pwehki KAUN-O mahsanih me re pahn tungoale oh pahn pil mie luhwe.”
Laduwo eri kihdiong irail mwenge ko, oh nin duwen me KAUN-O mahsanih, irail koaros tungoale, oh pil mie luhwarail.
